''See also: [[Seshethkunaaz Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Seshethkunaaz, also known as [[Sesh]], is the [[King of all Dragons|Monarch of Dragons]] and the King of all Dragons{{!}}King of Dragons. He rules over a lawless jungle territory on the eastern [[Ashwind continent]], where power is the only governing principle. Although he is a [[dragon]], he has lived for centuries in human form, often appearing as a young boy with sandy hair and golden eyes. This preference for a human aesthetic is shared by certain gold [[dragon]] bloodlines, as [[madra]] flows more smoothly through a human body. His history is marked by early hardship; born in the desert, he was an exile abandoned by his kind. He was eventually raised alongside a contractor as a brother, and they rose in power together until his adoptive brother was executed for murder. Seshethkunaaz is a significant political figure, maintaining a tense relationship with the [[Blackflame Empire]]. He is capable of immense displays of power, such as manifesting massive sandstorms and utilizing golden light. In his role as a monarch, he oversees his followers and participates in high-stakes competitions, where he has demonstrated both strategic thinking and a willingness to accept the outcomes of [[Fate|fate]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Seshethkunaaz takes the form of a cloaked human boy roughly thirteen years of age. He possesses sandy hair and bright golden eyes, often displaying a smile reminiscent of a serpent.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Seshethkunaaz is a figure of fear for [[Lindon]]. [[Reigan Shen]] communicated with the [[Monarch]] via [[vital aura]], while Seshethkunaaz spoke in whispers to [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]. Additionally, [[Yan Shoumei]] obtained an [[Ancient Scale]] from him, and [[Northstrider]] sensed his death from a great distance.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This [[Monarch]] can ascend upon a cloud of golden sand.}}
